title: Add VS Code Agents to Copilot usage metrics
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot usage metrics now expose dedicated VS Code Agents-window activity, making agent adoption measurable separately from generic Copilot usage.
actionable_takeaway: Create an Agent Adoption Receipt that separates window, editor, CLI, and desktop usage, and treats optional/null fields as unavailable rather than zero.

title: Auto-resolution and analysis updates in Copilot code review
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot code review can auto-resolve addressed comments and use broader shell tooling plus Lite-effort agent ensembles to improve review quality.
actionable_takeaway: Add a Review Closure Gate that records pre/post thread state, validation commands, still-open findings, ruleset status, and human acceptance.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - September 7
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Jira shared canvas, HydraFusion routing, VS Code recurring agent tasks, voice mode, and JetBrains sandbox policy appeared in the same release bundle, showing agent workflows becoming an operating loop.
actionable_takeaway: Write task capsules that connect requirement source, model routing, recurring execution, PR preparation, review closure, and permission evidence.

title: Refreshed repository pull requests page in public preview
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: The refreshed PR page adds stronger filtering, compact presentation, status counts, and unread indicators, which can become the human queue for agent-generated PRs.
actionable_takeaway: Use the page as a triage view only; final acceptance must still rely on diff, tests, rulesets, review state, and merge policy.

title: AI Scan for pull request APIs in public preview
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: AI Scan PR enablement can now be managed through REST API endpoints at organization and repository levels, making security gates scriptable for agent PR flows.
actionable_takeaway: Add AI Scan policy checks to PR automation setup receipts, including org/repo scope, enablement state, and fallback behavior when unavailable.

title: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: cache-mode lets teams apply least-privilege access to GitHub Actions cache at workflow or job level, reducing cache poisoning risk in automated PR and agent flows.
actionable_takeaway: Classify workflow cache access as read, write, write-only, or none; require annotation for any low-trust job with cache write permissions.

title: MAI-Code-1-Flash deprecated
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Model deprecation across Copilot surfaces is a reminder that agent workflows need a migration ledger rather than assuming model availability is stable.
actionable_takeaway: Scan configs and instructions for deprecated model names, choose a documented alternative, and run representative regression tasks before switching defaults.

title: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: The Xcode 27 runner image on macOS 27 gives iPhone/Mac workflows a new CI validation lane for Apple platform compatibility.
actionable_takeaway: Add the runner to an isolated Apple-lane matrix before using it as a required gate for agent-generated iOS/macOS changes.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-5 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds semantic JSONL session and memory import, grammar-generated completions, absolute sandbox paths, resource trust details, per-model AI credit breakdowns, and subagent preference fixes.
actionable_takeaway: Update CLI smoke tests for import, parsing, sandbox denial, resource trust, usage breakdown, streaming recovery, and explicit subagent preference inheritance.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-4 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease splits plugin, MCP, skill, instruction, and LSP commands and changes JSON output shape, which can break automation scripts reading old plugin structures.
actionable_takeaway: Create a command migration ledger for plugin/mcp/skill/instruction/lsp scripts and update JSON parsers that still expect a top-level .plugins object.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.0-alpha.3.10 prerelease
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155 alpha releases continued on September 11, showing active experimentation even though the release body is minimal.
actionable_takeaway: Keep alpha Codex builds in an isolated smoke lane and do not replace stable automations until version, behavior, permissions, and rollback are verified.

title: Rethinking skills and prompts for GPT-6 Astra
author: OpenAI Developers / Nisan Stiennon
why_it_matters: The piece argues for leaner skills and prompts that preserve boundaries, validation, context, and high-signal examples instead of encyclopedic instructions for frontier agents.
actionable_takeaway: Run a skill slimming audit: remove duplicated background and obsolete model-specific instructions while preserving safety boundaries, validation commands, and examples.
